# The angry are still trying

`customer_support.heu.de_escalation.the_angry_are_still_trying` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **heuristic**

> The loudest customers are usually the ones still trying. Worry harder about the polite short ones.


## The heuristic

**The loudest customers are usually the ones still trying. Worry harder about the polite short ones.**


_Why:_ Rage costs effort and effort is investment. The customer who has decided to leave writes a brief, courteous note and does not renew. That is the more dangerous state and it is the one no queue surfaces, because it generates no work.
